name: La Costanera
notes: Cliffside views of the Pacific. Ceviche and pisco sours on the agenda.

name: Plumed Horse
notes: One Michelin star in a charming Saratoga village setting. Long overdue.

name: The Sea by Alexander's Steakhouse
notes: Seafood-forward spin-off of the Alexander's empire. Omakase on request.

name: Flea St. Café
notes: Farm-to-table pioneer since 1980. The kind of place that earned that reputation.

name: DOMO Sushi
notes: Chef-driven omakase in a quiet strip mall. The best surprises come in humble packaging.

name: La Viga
notes: Mariscos and mezcal. A change of pace from the tasting-menu circuit.
